title: Ginger chicken and corn broth
summary: Ginger chicken and corn broth is a chinese dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Ginger chicken and corn broth. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken breast fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned sweetcorn.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until fresh root ginger is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Ginger chicken and corn broth before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Ginger chicken and corn broth.
